dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid, symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle visible in the lower half of the frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and symmetrical with no visible bulges or indentations where the skin meets the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to pale blue-grey median intensity, indicating a sub-adult or near-mature individual.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Subtle, low-frequency darker grey patches concentrated along the central longitudinal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the slightly darker axial pigmentation and the lighter lateral dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple short, linear high-contrast white markings oriented longitudinally along the central dorsal ridge, consistent with healed rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple linear depigmented scars on the upper dorsal surface.
